# PI SkillForge
> The Modular Intelligence & Reasoning Layer for LinkedIn Workflows by The PI Lab.

PI SkillForge is an open-source framework providing 40 contract-governed reasoning skills across 10 operational domains for LinkedIn workflows. It decouples reasoning logic from physical API execution through a swappable adapter boundary, enforcing Draft 2020-12 JSON schema validation and 6-gate governed self-evolution. Zero runtime dependencies. MIT licensed.

## Key Facts & Technical Specs
- Total Skills: 40 production reasoning modules
- Domains: 10 operational domains (Foundation, Content Engine, Prospecting, Outreach, Strategy, Automation, Data & CRM, Analytics & Intel, Talent & Career, Paid Campaigns)
- Schema Standard: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema
- Runtime Dependencies: 0 (Pure Python standard library)
- Supported IDEs / Runtimes: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, Cline, Roo Code, Zed, JetBrains, Neovim, and generic agent environments
- Maintainer: The PI Lab (Vinayak Mahavar)
- Repository: https://github.com/the-pi-lab/linkedin-skillforge
- Website: https://thepilab.in

## Core Domains & Skills
1. Foundation: profile-optimization, personal-branding, linkedin-seo
2. Content Engine: content-creation, copywriting, ai-content-generation, algorithm-optimization, content-scheduling
3. Prospecting: lead-generation, sales-navigator, prospect-research, b2b-prospecting, lead-qualification
4. Outreach: outreach-automation, cold-messaging, connection-strategy, social-selling, ai-personalization, appointment-setting, email-outreach-integration, networking
5. Strategy: sales-funnel, abm, growth-strategy, engagement-strategy
6. Automation: ai-agent-development, workflow-automation, automation-compliance
7. Data & CRM: crm-integration, data-enrichment
8. Analytics & Intel: analytics-reporting, competitor-analysis, market-research, conversion-tracking
9. Talent & Career: recruitment-automation, job-search-optimization, employer-branding
10. Paid Campaigns: ads-management, campaign-optimization, api-integration

## Governed Self-Evolution (6 Gates)
1. OBSERVE: Log production execution outcomes, confidence, and reviewer notes.
2. SCORE: Benchmark live IQ and measured behavior.
3. PROPOSE: Generate bounded diffs (never wild mutation).
4. VALIDATE: Enforce Draft 2020-12 schema validation, semver, and safety linting.
5. RELEASE: Require explicit human maintainer signoff.
6. MONITOR: Post-release regression and drift tracking.

## Enterprise Safety Principles
- Always: Human-in-the-loop interlocks on critical actions, audit trail first with provenance, strict volume caps, analysis-only fallback mode.
- Never (Hard Rejected): Session hijacking, cookie theft, DOM tampering scripts, CAPTCHA bypass, mass spamming, or rate-limit evasion.

## Quickstart CLI
- Clone: git clone https://github.com/the-pi-lab/linkedin-skillforge.git
- Test: python -m unittest discover -s tests
- Install Skill: python ide/install.py install --skill <skill-name> --ide auto --apply
